title: Larval Movement
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rxad7ie

steps.title: Prepare larvae in agar
steps.instruction: Place 48 third instar female larvae from each mitotype into petri dishes containing 0.5% agar.

steps.title: Isolate larvae in quadrants
steps.instruction: Place individual larvae into quadrants of separate petri dishes.

steps.title: Observe and measure movement
steps.instruction: Observe larvae for 60 seconds, trace their trails on the dish lids, and measure the distance moved independently by two investigators.

substeps.instruction: Immediately trace larvae trails onto the lid of each dish
Measure the distance moved by each larva independently by two investigators
